## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible outcome.

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] Public input/output/default changes were assessed for SemVer impact.
- [ ] No secret was added to a step that executes untrusted code.
- [ ] New external actions are pinned to full commit SHAs.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and documentation were updated when needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `actionlint`
- [ ] Relevant fixture or integration tests
